description: ArchetypeBuildingModel is published by VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland. It describes a Julia module that aggregates building-stock information into lumped-capacitance archetypes for flexible heating and cooling demand in larger energy-system models. Its scope is generic model use; applicability and spatial or temporal resolution depend on the supplied case and inputs. Access is through the public repository and its documentation. Repository code is primarily Julia. Software was not installed or executed. Licence: MIT.
